title: 第一卷 第14章 再哭我就挖出你的眼睛！
content_zh:
李伟松了口气，有了这块满相籍的令牌，返程路上便能省去不少麻烦。

    ——————

    另一边，陈渊与陈昭宁打探到王家府邸坐落于城北郊外，当即快步疾驰而去。

    “镇级地域虽无真正的法体境强者，但对方人手定然不少，哪怕皆是灵窍境，凭我们二人恐怕也难以抗衡……”

    一路疾驰，陈昭宁侧首对着身旁的陈渊沉声开口。

    陈渊环顾四周，见沿途街道人烟愈发稀少，心知目的地定然十分偏僻。

    “得找些爆发力更强的武器。”

    陈渊低声自语，伸手摸了摸腰间的铁刺。

    “什么？”

    陈昭宁没有听清他的话语。

    蓦地，前方一片竹林映入眼帘。

    “借你的刀一用。”

    陈渊在竹林前驻足，忽然开口道。

    陈昭宁没有迟疑，立刻将佩刀递了过去。

    陈渊挥刀砍下一根根青竹，又将竹梢一头削得尖锐锋利。

    “你这是在做什么？”

    陈昭宁满心疑惑。

    “缚龙搏杀术中有一式，名为断筋爪。”

    陈渊一边忙活，随口念出断筋爪的口诀，

    “爪出裂筋络，气走玄黄纲。”

    “近身无完骨，残躯坠寒江。”

    闻言，陈昭宁目光骤然一凝，但还是不明白对方要做什么，不由得开口，“你什么意思？”

    “我已是灵窍境大圆满，近乎触及法体境门槛，肉身气力远超常人。

    我可以试着，将这近身搏杀之术，化作远攻之法，借势爆发大规模的杀伤力。”

    陈渊一边修整竹竿，一边缓缓解释。

    陈昭宁：“？？？”

    她难以想象，灵窍境大圆满的修士，究竟能爆发出何等恐怖战力。

    灵窍数量越多，修炼速度便越快，所能储存的灵力也越发浑厚。

    寻常修士能开启百处灵窍，便已是妖孽天资。

    可陈渊，足足三百六十一处灵窍……念及此处，陈昭宁深吸一口气，心中满是期待。

    不多时，陈渊整理出十几根一米多长的竹竿，用身上破旧棉袄裹好，捆绑在一起，背在身后。

    “不知道我这灵窍数量，在这片地域算什么水准？应该还算合格吧？”

    收拾妥当，陈渊看向愣神呆滞的陈昭宁，好奇问道。

    “呃……”

    陈昭宁又是一声长叹，一时竟不知该如何言语。

    她简直想骂人。

    何止是合格？

    根本就是逆天妖孽！

    你不过修炼一年左右，便开了周身所有灵窍！

    那我苦修十年，才堪堪开启九十处灵窍，又算什么？

    是废物？

    还是废物都不如？
content_en:
Li Wei breathed a sigh of relief. With this token full of identity, he would be able to save a lot of trouble on the way back.

    ——————

    On the other side, Chen Yuan and Chen Zhaoning found out that the Wang family's residence was located on the northern outskirts of the city, and they quickly hurried away.

    "Although there are no real strong people in the legal body realm in the town-level area, the opponent must have a lot of people. Even if they are all in the spiritual orifice realm, it may be difficult for the two of us to compete..."

    As they galloped along, Chen Zhaoning turned his head and spoke in a deep voice to Chen Yuan beside him.

    Chen Yuan looked around and saw that the streets along the way were becoming increasingly sparse and he knew that his destination must be very remote.

    "We need to find some more explosive weapons."

    Chen Yuan whispered to himself and reached out to touch the iron thorn on his waist.

    "What?"

    Chen Zhaoning did not hear his words clearly.

    Suddenly, a bamboo forest ahead came into view.

    "I'll lend you your knife."

    Chen Yuan stopped in front of the bamboo forest and suddenly said.

    Chen Zhaoning did not hesitate and immediately handed over the sword.

    Chen Yuan swung his knife to chop down the green bamboos one by one, and then sharpened the ends of the bamboos.

    "What are you doing?"

    Chen Zhaoning was full of doubts.

    "There is a move in the dragon-binding fighting technique called the tendon-breaking claw."

    While Chen Yuan was busy, he casually recited the formula for breaking tendons and claws.

    "The claws burst out and crack the tendons, and the energy travels through the Xuanhuang Gang."

    "There are no intact bones in the body, and the remains of the body fell into the cold river."

    Hearing this, Chen Zhaoning's eyes suddenly condensed, but he still didn't understand what the other party was going to do, so he couldn't help but ask, "What do you mean?"

    "I have reached the Great Perfection of the Spiritual Aperture Realm, almost touching the threshold of the Dharma Body Realm, and my physical strength far exceeds that of ordinary people.

    I can try to turn this close-quarters fighting technique into a long-distance attack method, and use the opportunity to explode large-scale lethality. "

    Chen Yuan explained slowly while trimming the bamboo pole.

    Chen Zhaoning: "???"

    It was hard for her to imagine what kind of terrifying combat power a monk in the Dzogchen Realm of Spiritual Aperture could unleash.

    The greater the number of spiritual orifices, the faster the cultivation speed, and the richer the spiritual power that can be stored.

    If an ordinary monk can open hundreds of spiritual apertures, he is already a monster.

    But Chen Yuan has a total of three hundred and sixty-one spiritual apertures... Thinking of this, Chen Zhaoning took a deep breath, full of expectation.

    Not long after, Chen Yuan sorted out a dozen bamboo poles more than one meter long, wrapped them in his old cotton-padded jacket, tied them together, and carried them behind his back.

    "I wonder how many spiritual orifices I have, how good they are in this area? I should be considered qualified, right?"

    After packing up, Chen Yuan looked at the stunned Chen Zhaoning and asked curiously.

    "Uh..."

    Chen Zhaoning let out another long sigh, and for a moment he didn't know what to say.

    She just wanted to curse.

    More than just qualified?

    He is simply an evil monster!

    You have only been practicing for about a year and you have opened all the spiritual apertures in your body!

    So what does it mean that I have only been able to open ninety spiritual apertures after ten years of hard training?

    Is it trash?

    Or worse than trash?
title_en: Volume 1 Chapter 14 If you cry again, I will dig out your eyes!
